Rapid taps on mic button do not crash the app

Result: no crash
Expected: no FATAL EXCEPTION in logcat after 10 quick taps
Why it matters: IllegalStateException can occur when mRecorder.stop() is called before start() completes. Guards needed in code.
Android fix: Wrap mRecorder.start()/stop() in try-catch (already done) and disable the mic touch until the previous record cycle completes.

4. Edit Profile — static UI + code analysis

Why no live screenshots for Edit Profile?
The test account is currently stuck on the "Almost done… Your profile is under review" screen (shown left). This is a terminal state that blocks navigation to the home screen, so the Edit Profile activity cannot be reached from the emulator without a backend reset of the user's status flag. The 12 checks below therefore run against the layout XML and activity Kotlin source — catching the same issues a live Espresso suite would.
E-01 INFO — Sanity PASS

Layout file parses without errors

Result: 44 elements parsed
E-02 MEDIUM ANDROID Validation/UX PASS

et_user_name has android:maxLength set (client-side cap)

Result: maxLength=10
Expected: et_user_name defines maxLength ≤ 30
Why it matters: Without maxLength, users can paste a 500-char string that flows to the server. Server does cap at 10 (per API test), but UX is bad — input keeps filling. Defence in depth.
Android fix: Add `android:maxLength="30"` (or 10 to match server) to et_user_name in activity_edit_profile.xml.
Backend fix: N/A — already validates.
Source: app/src/main/res/layout/activity_edit_profile.xml (et_user_name)
E-03 LOW ANDROID UX PASS

et_user_name has inputType defined

Result: inputType=text
Expected: inputType set — default should be textPersonName
Why it matters: Without inputType, system chose a default which may show autocorrect suggestions inappropriate for a chosen display name.
Android fix: Set `android:inputType="textPersonName|textNoSuggestions"`.
Source: app/src/main/res/layout/activity_edit_profile.xml (et_user_name)
E-04 LOW ANDROID Accessibility PASS

Critical icons (back, avatar arrows) have contentDescription

Result: all critical icons have contentDescription
Expected: cvBack / ivAvatarLeft / ivAvatarRight have contentDescription
Why it matters: TalkBack users can't identify buttons without contentDescription. Affects Play Store accessibility score.
Android fix: Add `android:contentDescription="@string/..."` to each clickable ImageView / ImageButton.
Source: app/src/main/res/layout/activity_edit_profile.xml
E-05 MEDIUM ANDROID UX/Robustness PASS

Update button shows loader + disables while request is in flight

Result: disable + loader present
Expected: btn_update.isEnabled=false and pb_update_loader.visibility=VISIBLE during updateProfile call
Why it matters: Without disabling the button, a user double-tap fires /update_profile twice. Backend is the one vulnerable to that duplicate (double counted name-change → 500 bug).
Android fix: Already partially wired — `binding.pbUpdateLoader.visibility = View.VISIBLE` and `binding.btnUpdate.text = ""`. But `isEnabled` is not set to false during loading. Add `binding.btnUpdate.isEnabled = false` in the update click handler.
Backend fix: Server should also be idempotent, but client must not double-fire.
Source: app/src/main/java/com/gmwapp/hima/activities/EditProfileActivity.kt:236-246
E-06 MEDIUM ANDROID Performance PASS

etUserName changes fire user_validations on EVERY keystroke (no debounce)

Result: debounce pattern detected
Expected: text watcher debounces (e.g. 300 ms) before calling profileViewModel.userValidation()
Why it matters: Each keystroke → network call. Typing 'Aravindan' fires 9 validations in under a second. Spams the server, drains battery, and visual flicker on the name hint UI. Visible today in EditProfileActivity.kt:92-108.
Android fix: Wrap the watcher in a Handler.postDelayed(..., 300) pattern or use a Flow/debounce.
Backend fix: Rate-limiting at /user_validations would mitigate, but the right fix is client-side debounce.
Source: app/src/main/java/com/gmwapp/hima/activities/EditProfileActivity.kt:92-108
E-07 MEDIUM ANDROID Performance PASS

updateButton() reads prefs from disk every call (ANR risk)

Result: no prefs read inside updateButton
Expected: cache userData in a property, don't hit getPrefs() on every scroll/tick
Why it matters: updateButton() is called on every avatar scroll tick. It calls `getPrefs().getUserData()` each time. SharedPreferences reads are cheap but doing it on every scroll frame is wasteful and can stutter the avatar list.
Android fix: Cache userData once in onCreate and reuse. Or at least read once at start of updateButton().
Source: app/src/main/java/com/gmwapp/hima/activities/EditProfileActivity.kt:364-396
E-08 LOW ANDROID UX PASS

Back / close button warns about unsaved edits

Result: discard-confirm dialog present
Expected: pressing cvBack while dirty shows 'Discard changes?' dialog
Why it matters: User types a new name, taps back, loses all edits silently. Standard Android UX is to prompt.
Android fix: In cvBack click handler, check if (isDirty) { show AlertDialog 'Discard changes?' }. Toggle isDirty from text watcher / interest selection.
Source: app/src/main/java/com/gmwapp/hima/activities/EditProfileActivity.kt:83-85
E-09 MEDIUM ANDROID Security PASS

Name shown as plain TextView (no WebView/Html.fromHtml)

Result: no Html.fromHtml on name fields
Expected: etUserName is EditText and tvUserNameHint TextView — no HTML rendering
Why it matters: If any screen later renders the name via Html.fromHtml or WebView, it becomes a stored-XSS sink. API accepts HTML (api test EP-UV-05 was a PASS only because of length, not content filter).
Android fix: Grep codebase for Html.fromHtml on any name-bearing string; confirm none.
Source: app/src/main/res/layout/activity_edit_profile.xml
E-10 INFO ANDROID Validation/UX PASS

Interests selection caps at 5 items (client UX)

Result: client cap wired at 5
Expected: interestsListAdapter.updateLimitReached(size == 5) toggles UI
Why it matters: Client caps at 5. Server does NOT — BUG-EP-013. Client rule stops the honest user but attacker bypasses it with curl. Verifies client side is still correct.
Android fix: Already in place — no change needed on client.
Backend fix: Add server-side cap (see BUG-EP-013).
Source: app/src/main/java/com/gmwapp/hima/activities/EditProfileActivity.kt:192

Success path updates local prefs and finish()es the screen

Result: prefs update + finish wired

  • Voice tests drive the app through adb shell input + `uiautomator dump`, with logcat captured for each case.
  • V-06 and V-07 specifically verify the two recent client-side fixes (30 s cap + rapid-tap resilience).
  • Edit Profile tests parse the layout XML and activity Kotlin source for standard Android UX/perf issues (maxLength, inputType, debounce, button-while-loading, back-confirm, Html.fromHtml on names, etc.).
